verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a 'Timecard sync' field among the time-off policy setup options. This implies Justworks has timecards that sync with PTO policies. Nothing in the pack shows hourly time entries or overtime being calculated and fed automatically into a payroll run. missing for 10: documentation of hourly time tracking, overtime calculation, automatic flow of approved hours and overtime into payroll, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
